title: tc-run-manifest
description:
A run's reproducibility record: model, settings, instruction hash, sources, intent and the verification summary,
with copy and export.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

runId.description: The run's id – shown under the heading, with a copy button

timestamp.description: When the run happened, shown as given – e.g. "Oct 24, 14:02 UTC"

model.description: The model's display name, shown as a badge in the head

modelId.description: The model's exact id or version – what reproducing the run needs; shown in full with a copy button

settings.description: Sampling and other settings, in order: temperature, top-p, maximum tokens, seed…

instructionLabel.description: The instruction's name or version, e.g. "Analyst v4"

instructionHash.description: The instruction's hash – shown shortened, copied in full

sources.description: The sources and corpus the run drew on

sourceLimit.description: How many sources show before "Show all"

intent.description: The intent the session was started with, in the person's words

verification.description: Claims per verification state: verified, unverifiable, incorrect, dismissed, pending

noun.description: What the verified things are called, plural – "claims"

detail.description: A quiet second line – size, version, when it was indexed
